item.title: Moroccan Tape Stash preserves Morocco's cassette music heritage
item.description: Moroccan Tape Stash is an excellent blog that features music from Moroccan cassettes and aims to spread appreciation for Moroccan music and artists. The blog has been around since 2011 and is curated impressively. Many of the cassettes, according to blog creator Tim Abdellah Fuson, "are not available outside of Morocco." — Read the rest The post Moroccan Tape Stash preserves Morocco's cassette music heritage appeared first on Boing Boing.

item.title: Orphaned otters rescued and on the mend
item.description: Two baby otters found alone in a field in England are said to be doing well after being taken to a rescue center. "Barely able to crawl" when spotted by a member of the public, the pair—thought to have lost their mother in a flood—will remain at South Essex Wildlife Hospital for up to a year: "Then we will try to find a good bit of river for them to be released into," said Sue Schwar, who founded and has operated the hospital for 38 years. — Read the rest The post Orphaned otters rescued and on
